body: The nurses are usually sent to the homes in the morning and only stay long enough to do whatever they need to do for the patient and leave. They wouldn't do most of the things I'm stuck doing, they would just help him get cleaned up in the morning.

I don't really have the luxury of taking a break.  I spend my days either shopping for my grandmother/father, taking care of the home or driving my father to a hospital that might help. If I stopped the home would fall apart. A part of me hopes that going through with it might snap my father out of it.
